title: Peace in the Middle of the Storm
opening: Jesus’ disciples faced a storm, and Scripture reminds us that fear can be met with prayer, trust, wise action, and the presence of Christ.
points: Name what is troubling you and bring it to God in prayer.
Focus on what is true and helpful rather than feeding panic.
Take sensible action and seek assistance when a problem is beyond your strength.
reflection: What can you entrust to God and address one step at a time?
prayer: Prince of Peace, steady my heart. Guide my thoughts, give me wisdom, and help me receive support as I face today’s challenges. Amen.
ministry: Grace Fire Deliverance Healing Global Word Ministry
author: Daily Bible Teaching Team
